Name: Rodney Deserves It Too (And Elliott Doesn't) - A Hair Mod
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
This mod gives Rodney, the custom NPC from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13437][i]Creative Differences[/i][/url], his nephew's luscious hair.

[b][color=#dd7e6b][size=6]F[/size][size=5]eatures[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Give Rodney what he deserves.
[*]Take from Elliott what he doesn't deserve.
[*]Three portrait art styles are available: the default style, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25562][i]Fire Emblem[/i] style[/url] by AvianRPG, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu style[/url].
[*]Fully configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i][/url], so you can have both people be bald or be hairy if you want.
[*]You can just make Elliott bald without installing Rodney I suppose if you [i]really [/i]don't want to but why.
[/list](Disclaimer: this mod is made in jest. Elliott is cool, and bald Elliott is also cool.)

[color=#b4a7d6][b][size=6]C[/size][size=5]redits
[/size][/b][/color](for work done specifically for this mod)[list]
